manifest_title: Legal Copilot — Egyptian legal source registry
purpose: Track candidate sources and the legal, technical, and licensing checks required before collection or reuse.

policy.rule: A publicly accessible page is not automatically public domain, bulk-exportable, or licensed for commercial reuse. Confirm terms for storage, indexing, embeddings, model processing, redistribution, and commercial use separately.

sources.name: Amiri Press / Official Gazette and Egyptian Proceedings
sources.access_method: Official Amiri Press portal and DSpace Gazette catalog; exact Supplement 225(A) record is public, but its original PDF currently routes to a request-a-copy form
sources.access_status: public_catalog_record_located_for_supplement_225A; original 6.13 MB PDF bundle request-copy restricted; bytes not obtained
sources.license_status: unknown; request terms for bulk digital reuse
sources.automation_policy: check terms and technical rules before automated retrieval
verification_requirements: retain Gazette name, issue, date, page range
record publication and effective dates separately
Do not bypass repository access controls; obtain a lawful public official full-text route or a user-supplied authorized copy

For Supplement 225(A) dated 2026-10-12, preserve DSpace item https://dspace.id.com.eg/items/9cf7c0e9-002a-4467-9d35-e0bb26f81657/full and handle https://dspace.id.com.eg/handle/123456789/8906; original bundle metadata: العدد 225 تابع أ - مؤمن.pdf, 6.13 MB
sources.notes: Preferred primary publication provenance for enacted texts. Exact Gazette Supplement 225(A) catalog record identified on 2026-10-30; metadata lists Decisions 248–252/2026. The original bundle is request-copy restricted in the checked session. Catalog identity does not prove file acquisition, currentness, or reuse rights.

sources.name: Court of Cassation judgment search
sources.access_status: public_search_portal_exists; full-text availability varies and must be tested
sources.license_status: unknown; confirm reuse and database rights
sources.automation_policy: no scraping until terms and access rules are reviewed
sources.notes: Record exact citation and whether the result is a full decision or summary.

sources.name: Supreme Constitutional Court
sources.notes: Separate constitutional holdings from summaries and commentary.

sources.name: Public Prosecution legal encyclopedia
sources.access_method: Website; some pages may require login or permissions
sources.license_status: unknown; request permission for bulk use
sources.automation_policy: do not bypass authentication or restrictions
verification_requirements: verify referenced legal text against official source
record access level and page URL
sources.notes: Discovery index; not every item should be assumed public or reusable.

sources.name: Presidency of Egypt — Constitution
sources.access_status: public_page_candidate; validate exact URL and current content
sources.notes: Use as discovery/corroboration; preserve constitutional version.

sources.name: Ministry of Labour — laws and legislation
sources.access_status: public_page_candidate; verify availability and archive completeness
sources.notes: Labour Law 14/2025 requires careful commencement, transitional, and amendment tracking.

sources.name: Arab Legal Portal
content_types: legal materials; exact coverage to verify
sources.access_method: Portal; access model must be tested
sources.notes: Do not assume this portal is the same as a government-operated database without confirming.

sources.name: House of Representatives
sources.notes: Useful for legislative history; a bill is not current law merely because it is published.

sources.name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.notes: Treaty status must be tracked separately from signature.

sources.name: Ministry of Justice — portal/discovery
sources.access_status: verify current route and relevant repositories
verification_requirements: record issuing authority and source URL
sources.notes: Registry entry is for discovery; identify specific datasets before collection.

sources.name: Egyptian Tax Authority
verification_requirements: record effective dates and tax year
sources.notes: Tax guidance and binding legislation must be stored as different source classes.

sources.name: Egyptian Customs Authority
sources.notes: Tariffs and annual changes need temporal versioning.

sources.name: Central Bank of Egypt
sources.access_status: verify document catalogue and historical circular access
sources.notes: Some supervisory material may be restricted or context-dependent.

sources.name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones
verification_requirements: connect guidance to statute and executive regulations
sources.notes: Useful for investment and company formation practice areas.

sources.name: National Telecom Regulatory Authority
sources.notes: Relevant to telecommunications, privacy and technology matters.

sources.name: Library of Congress — Egypt legal research guide
verification_requirements: use guide to find primary sources; do not cite guide as law
sources.notes: Discovery tool, not a legal authority.

sources.name: WIPO Lex
sources.license_status: review WIPO terms and individual document rights
verification_requirements: check current version and official source
sources.notes: Specialist discovery source for intellectual property.

sources.name: ILO NATLEX
sources.license_status: review ILO terms and underlying source rights
verification_requirements: verify current status against Egyptian primary source
sources.notes: Useful labour-law discovery and comparative research.

sources.name: FAOLEX
sources.license_status: review FAO and underlying document terms
sources.notes: Sector-specific discovery.

sources.name: Cyrilla
sources.license_status: review site terms and source-level rights
sources.notes: Potential discovery source for digital rights and technology laws.

sources.name: Wajid / واجد
sources.access_method: Commercial platform; account/pricing terms to confirm
sources.license_status: must obtain written licence for storing/indexing/reuse
sources.bulk_export: not_confirmed; ask about API and full-text export
sources.automation_policy: do not scrape without written authorization
sources.notes: Website has advertised large corpus counts; treat counts as vendor claims until independently verified.

sources.name: Haqy / حقي
sources.access_method: Commercial platform; account/pricing terms to confirm
sources.license_status: must obtain written licence for storing/indexing/reuse
sources.notes: Extracted-document export, if offered, is not the same as bulk export of the vendor's database.

sources.name: LegalMind
sources.license_status: written permission required for reuse of platform data
sources.notes: Treat generated answers as research leads, not source law.

sources.name: HAQQ Legal AI
sources.access_status: verify Egypt coverage on actual subscription
sources.license_status: review product terms and source rights
sources.bulk_export: some extracted-data export features may not include underlying database
sources.notes: Distinguish exporting a user's documents from exporting vendor-owned corpus.

sources.name: Laiwyer
sources.access_status: verify Egypt support in current product/plan
sources.notes: Do not assume a multi-jurisdiction claim guarantees Egyptian coverage.

sources.name: LexVira — Egypt jurisdiction source map
sources.license_status: review site terms and underlying sources
sources.notes: May be a source directory rather than a full text corpus.

sources.name: Egyptian legal textbooks and commentaries (publisher-specific registry required)
sources.access_method: Purchase, licensed digital library, university library, or author/publisher permission
sources.access_status: not_a_single_source; catalogue titles and editions individually
sources.license_status: copyright-protected unless specific licence says otherwise
sources.automation_policy: do not scan, scrape, or ingest full texts without permission
sources.notes: Use books as commentary, never silently merge commentary into statutory text. Store bibliographic metadata and licensed excerpts only.

sources.name: Egyptian law journals and academic articles (publisher-specific registry required)
sources.access_method: Publisher subscription, university access, open-access repository or author permission
sources.notes: Use as secondary analysis and attach citations; do not represent opinions as binding law.

sources.name: Commercial legal databases and law-firm libraries (vendor-specific registry required)
sources.access_status: identify providers and test actual account coverage
sources.license_status: subscription access does not automatically grant bulk extraction or commercial reuse
sources.automation_policy: no automation until contract and provider terms permit it
sources.notes: Negotiate dataset/API access rather than scraping a browser UI.
